pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

5. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Total Number of Lessons 90 Page 12 of 73 1 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Farewell Pilgrimage Sermon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. B — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. D — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Farewell Pilgrimage Sermon; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
